title: EmbeddedServiceCustomComponent - Tooling API
description: Represents a custom component created for an Embedded Service feature. The custom components can be an Aura or Lightning Web Component. This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

CustomComponentId.description: The unique ID of the LightningComponentBundle or AuraDefinitionBundle component to be used in the Embedded Service.

CustomComponentType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CustomComponentType.description: The embedded component type associated with the chosen Feature that you want to customize. The possible values are: LA_ChatHeader—Not supported for AuraDefinitionBundle components LA_Minimized LA_PlainTextChatMessage—Not supported for AuraDefinitionBundle components LA_Prechat

EmbeddedServiceConfigId.description: The unique ID of the EmbeddedServiceConfig object that this custom component is associated with.

Feature.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Feature.description: The Embedded Service feature that uses the custom component. The possible values are: Base ChannelMenu FieldService Flows LiveAgent NotInUse

special_access_rules: This type is available only if Salesforce Experiences and Salesforce Sites are enabled in your org. To access this type, you need the Customize Application user permission.
wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="EmbeddedServiceCustomComponent">
  <xsd:complexContent>
    <xsd:extension base="ens:sObject">
      <xsd:sequence>
        <xsd:element name="CreatedBy" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="CreatedById" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="CreatedDate" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="CustomComponent" minOccurs="0" type="ens:sObject" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="CustomComponentId" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="CustomComponentType" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="EmbeddedServiceConfig" minOccurs="0" type="ens:EmbeddedServiceConfig" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="EmbeddedServiceConfigId" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="Feature" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="IsDeleted" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="LastModifiedBy" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="LastModifiedById" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="LastModifiedDate" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>
        <xsd:element name="SystemModstamp" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime" nillable="true"/>
      </xsd:sequence>
    </xsd:extension>
  </xsd:complexContent>
</xsd:complexType>
<xsd:simpleType name="EmbeddedServiceCustomComponentType">
  <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
    <xsd:enumeration value="LA_Prechat"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="LA_Minimized"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="LA_PlainTextChatMessage"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="LA_ChatHeader"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="MIAW_Prechat"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="MIAW_Header"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="MIAW_TextMessage"/>
  </xsd:restriction>
</xsd:simpleType>
```
